outcome: Pay the representative Provider's live re-observation once for all the source changes that have accumulated since the last one, under a fresh approved record with room for the transient failures every previous observation actually hit, and prove the corrected working directory reaches the real child.
non_goals: Do not raise a spent record's thresholds or reinitialise a ledger; issue a new record instead
Do not widen the exercise beyond what the earlier live records covered plus the working directory
Do not accept an argument in place of the measured intersection

transitions.reason: four tasks in a row landed changes inside the file set the live exercise compiles, and each of them recorded that the existing live records lose their measured freshness as a result. Paying one observation for all of them costs one approved record instead of four, and it is the only way to close the working-directory task's own live half, which it was told to defer. Every previous observation spent its entire allowance, one to three invocations of it on provider-side transient failures, so the new record needs room for that rather than the same number again
